findings.title: Providing any non-empty totpCode with a backupCode bypasses password verification
findings.body: In `authorize`, password verification on line 121 is guarded by `if (user.password && !credentials.totpCode)`, while the new backup code branch on line 131 (`if (user.twoFactorEnabled && credentials.backupCode)`) executes before the `else if (user.twoFactorEnabled)` TOTP verification branch and never validates `credentials.totpCode`. If a request supplies both a non-empty `totpCode` (e.g., `"1"`) and a `backupCode`, `verifyPassword` is skipped and the user is authenticated using only the backup code without verifying either their password or TOTP token.

findings.title: Closing the modal on the backup codes step without clicking 'Close' leaves 2FA UI state out of sync and form state dirty
findings.body: When `TwoFactorAuthAPI.enable(totpCode)` returns HTTP 200 in `handleEnable`, 2FA is already enabled on the server, but `onEnable()` is now deferred until the user clicks the `backup-codes-close` button (line 269). If the user dismisses the dialog at `SetupStep.DisplayBackupCodes` by pressing Escape or clicking the backdrop (`onOpenChange`), neither `onEnable()` nor `resetState()` runs, leaving the 2FA switch on the settings page unchecked even though 2FA is enabled in the database. In addition, `resetState()` (lines 71-75) never clears `totpCode` in `form`, so the 6-digit code remains in React Hook Form state if the modal is cancelled or reopened without reloading the page.

findings.title: First 2FA E2E test does not awaitbackup code completion and races with /auth/logout
findings.body: In the first test (`"should allow a user to enable 2FA and login using 2FA"`), after `fillOtp` fills the 6th digit (lines 44-48), the test does not wait for the backup codes step or click `backup-codes-close`. Line 52 (`waitForSelector('[data-testid=two-factor-switch]')`) resolves immediately because the switch is already in the DOM behind the modal, and line 53 (`expect(page.locator('[data-testid=two-factor-switch]').isChecked()).toBeTruthy()`) passes an unawaited `Promise<boolean>` to `toBeTruthy()`, which always passes immediately. The test then navigates to `/auth/logout` on line 59 while the `/api/auth/two-factor/totp/enable` POST request triggered by `fillOtp` may still be in flight.

findings.title: Passing type="password" to PasswordField breaks the show/hide password toggle
findings.body: `EnableTwoFactorModal` switches from `TextField` to `PasswordField` on line 174 but still passes `type="password"` on line 176. In `packages/ui/components/form/inputs/Input.tsx` (lines 35-39), `PasswordField` renders `<InputField type={isPasswordVisible ? "text" : "password"} ... {...props} />`, spreading `{...props}` after its computed `type`. Passing `type="password"` in `props` overrides the toggle state so clicking the eye icon button never reveals the password.

findings.title: Cancelling or closing DisableTwoFactorModal does not reset twoFactorLostAccess, form values, or errors
findings.body: `resetForm()` and `setTwoFactorLostAccess(false)` are only called when disabling 2FA succeeds (lines 60-61), not when the user clicks Cancel (`onClick={onCancel}` on line 122) or dismisses the dialog (`onOpenChange` on line 89). If a user switches to the backup code view or triggers an error and then cancels and reopens the modal, it reopens on the backup code screen with the stale error message and form values still present.
